name: smwpatches-super-mario-land
title: Super Mario Land 2-Styled Spinjump
description:
Makes it so you need to be big and hold the down key for spinjumping, just like in Super Mario Land 2. This would also allow you to spinjump no matter if you press A or B.

Requested by LMPuny and updated by LMPuny. lol

Update: Now you can duck jump, and it won't break the sliding status if droping when sliding and still holding down (will trigger when pressing rather than holding, thx Maarfy for the idea)
